name: Pocket Dictionary
description: Look up any word in English or Spanish with your AI: meanings, examples, pronunciation, synonyms, a translation and where it comes from.
prompt: A dictionary powered by the AI: look up a word in English, Spanish or translate between them, with IPA pronunciation, parts of speech, definitions with examples, synonyms and opposites you can tap, translation and origin, a speak button, a word of the day and recent words.
author: gonzaroman
